title: St.john the baptist malankara church
description:
This project involved the complete renovation of the church, covering both the exterior architecture and the interior sanctuary. The façade was refreshed with detailed Gothic-inspired elements, pointed arches, ornamental features and restored architectural finishes.

Inside, the sanctuary was transformed with rich wooden paneling, intricate decorative work, a custom altar backdrop and carefully integrated lighting, creating a warm and dignified space for worship.

The project focused on bringing together craftsmanship, architectural detailing and modern renovation techniques, while maintaining the traditional character and spiritual essence of the church.
